Because of your longstanding employment with the Company and direct knowledge of key matters continuing after February 1, 2027, the Company wishes to secure your continued employment as a strategic advisor to the Executive Chairman through May 3, 2027 (your &#8220;Separation Date&#8221;).  Your employment with us will end as of May 3, 2027, which is the &#8220;Separation Date&#8221; and is also your retirement date for purposes of incentive and benefit plans. Beginning on February 1, 2027, and continuing until your Separation Date (the &#8220;Advisory Period&#8221;), you will serve as a strategic advisor to the Executive Chairman.  During this Advisory Period, you will also take remaining, accrued vacation leave.  You will receive your regular base salary during this Advisory Period.  Unless otherwise requested by the Company, you are not required to report to work during your Advisory Period.  You will, however, be expected to be available to answer general questions and provide reasonable assistance as required by the Executive Chairman to facilitate the transition of your duties and responsibilities and to otherwise fulfil your cooperation obligations contemplated by Paragraph 9.</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:12.20pt;text-decoration:underline">Additional Consideration</font></div><div style="text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt">In exchange for your acceptance of this Agreement, including Paragaphs 1 through 21 below, specifically also including your continuing obligations through December 31, 2027 in Paragraphs 7 (non-solicitation) and 9 (cooperation), we will pay you a lump-sum cash payment in the amount of $170,000, less standard deductions and withholdings required by law, payable no later than thirty days after your Separation Date. In addition to this Paragraph 5, the confidentiality obligations contained in your existing employment documents continue to survive.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Aptos',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt"> </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt">Additionally, notwithstanding anything in this Agreement to the contrary, you agree not to actively participate in and use confidential business information in any transaction or stockholder proposal directly involving Teledyne, its management, its Board of Directors or its stockholders, in each case to the extent it relates to Teledyne.&#160; </font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt">6.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:12.20pt;padding-left:8.9pt;text-decoration:underline">We Can Take Court Action If You Disclose or Misuse Our Confidential Business Information.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:12.20pt"> </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt">We depend on our valuable &#34;confidential business information&#34; and we will be irreparably harmed by any violation of your obligation to keep our &#8220;confidential business information&#8221; confidential and not to misuse it.  If we believe that you have committed or will commit an improper disclosure or use of such information, we can take legal action in a court of law or equity, and we can seek an injunction and any other relief that is appropriate, from a court or a private arbitrator (at the Company&#8217;s sole election) prohibiting you from any violation or threatened violation of the obligations in this and the preceding Paragraphs 4 and 5. You may not be held criminally or civilly liable under any federal or state trade secret law for the disclosure of a trade secret that (a) is made (i) in confidence to a federal, state, or local government official, either directly or indirectly, or to an attorney&#59; and (ii) solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation or law&#59; or (b) is made in a complaint or other document that is filed under seal in a lawsuit or other proceeding.  </font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt">7.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:12.20pt;padding-left:8.9pt;text-decoration:underline">You Have a Limited Non-Solicitation Period.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt"> Through December 31, 2027, you shall not, directly or indirectly, hire, solicit or recruit any employee of the Company to leave their employment with the Company, nor cause an employee of the Company to be contacted, for the purpose of leaving employment with the Company. A general advertisement by your new employer or associated group that is not directed specifically at employees of the Company shall not be deemed a violation of the preceding sentence.</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Courier',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt"> </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:12.20pt">For purposes of this Paragraph 7, Company specifically includes its parents, affiliates, subsidiaries, predecessors, amalgamated companies, related entities, segments, and business units.
